title: Granular
identify: Visible grains, bumps, or uneven microstructure.
This project splits the manual's 'Rough / Granular': granular = distinct small grains, sand-like.
recognition: Irregular fine shadows and grain-like features.
source: Ceramic Attribute Taxonomy (craze documentaries.pdf) p.5 (value 'Rough / Granular')

confused_with.difference: Rough = uneven bumpy relief without separate grains (the split is this project's vocabulary).
confused_with.source: general description - not defined in your reference manuals

confused_with.difference: Speckles are coloured dots in a smooth glaze, not raised grains.
